card.text:
General proposes a contact-permission change. Nothing changes until an admin confirms.
Room: Demo room
Mode: Not restricted (older setting) → Restricted
In restricted mode, requests from people who aren't admins to other agents wait for approval.
Switching on treats earlier conversation history as an unknown requester.
If the CLI doesn't support this protection, the agent keeps its current tool permissions.

General proposes a contact-permission change. Nothing changes until an admin confirms.
Contact request #Rbf04ff6e from Demo room (a message between agents)
Allow Demo person (Discord) to contact Demo worker until Tue 12/1 10:41
This only lets the message through; it doesn't approve what the receiving agent does with it.
